scope: The standing National Museum of India on Janpath, including the north polygonal block, circular sculpture courtyard, adjoining old Archaeological Survey of India wing, exterior cladding and the mapped entrance.

terrain.notes: The independent Terrarium surface bridges the open court. A runtime opening is bounded to the named court outline; the original field is reviewed and the source elevations remain unchanged.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: The Janpath building opened in December 1960 and the second phase was completed in 1989.
The museum’s descriptions identify the three levels, separate wings, entrance hall, and ground-floor sculpture rotundas.
The national government records an official event at the standing Janpath museum in May 2026.
The newer Yuge Yugeen Bharat Museum project occupies the distinct North and South Block complex.
